tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor dngos gzhi'i khrid yig cung zad spros pa sems kyi rdo rje'i nges gnas gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba legs par bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma sems kyi rdo rje la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ji lta'i gnas lugs don bzhin nyer gzigs pas// ji snyed shes byar mkhyen bzang pad+ma'i 'dab// rgya cher rgyas pa'i spyan yangs rtsa brgyud kyi// rdo rje can rnams zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud// dri mas ma bslad stong gsal gzhi'i gnas lugs// rang bzhin yongs shes ma yengs lam gyi mchog /sku dang ye shes lhun rdzogs 'bras bu'i chos// rnam gsum phyag rgyas 'gro 'di skyongs gyur cig /rgya chen chos kun snying po'i thig le mchog /grub brnyes bye ba'i thugs bcud myur bde'i lam// rtog ge'i rna bar bzod dka'i gtam chen po// rdo rje 'chang rgyal phyag rgya'i mthar thug pa// tshul 'dis skal ldan khrid thabs tshig nyung yang*// rgya chen don lhongs zab mo'i byin rgyas par// dpal ldan pad+ma dkar pos nyer stsal gang*// cung zad spros pas nyan 'dod tshim par bya// 'dir kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma dkar po'i gsung gsang phyag rgya chen po'i dngos gzhi'i khrid yig zab mo gnad kyi snying po 'di nyid cung zad spros nas 'chad thabs kyi reg zig bgyid pa la zhugs so// 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ sngon 'gro la yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis su yod pa'i snga ma'i khrid tshul spros pa ni gzhan du bshad par bya la// 'dir ni thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro nas brtsams te ston no// de yang 'di skad ces 'doms par bya ste/ 'dir tha mal gyi shes rgyud yang dag pa'i ye shes su ngo sprod par byed pa phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid 'di 'chad pa skabs su bab pa yin te/ rang re rnams myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid can de thob par 'dun pa la/ der 'jug lam mtha' yas pa kun gyi rab dang phul dang snying por gyur pa ni nges don phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba sems kyi rdo rje mngon par spyod pa'i lam gyi rim pa 'di nyid do// de yang snang zhing srid pa'am 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang 'char gzhi dang srog tu gyur pa rang gi sems nyid kho na ste/

mdo sde sa bcu pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo// zhes dang*/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sems can med cing sangs rgyas med// ces dang sam+bu ṭi las/ phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can// 'di dag thams cad sems kyis btags// sems las ma gtogs pa nyid ni// gzhan du yod pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ ri khrod dbang phyug gis/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems yin te// sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan rdul tsam med/ ces so// des na da ltar phyi rol gzugs sgra la sogs pa'i dngos po sems las rdzas gzhan rang rkya thub pa'i sde tshan 'ga' zhig yod pa ltar snang ba'ang sems nyid rang gi gnas lugs ma rig par thog ma med pa nas bdag gzhan gnyis su snang bar gyur cing*/ der 'dzin pa'i rtog pas bag chags bsags pas 'khrul ngor phyir rol gyi don du shar ba tsam ste/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems// don du snang ba rab tu byung*// don yod ma yin sems nyid de// phyi rol don mthong log pa yin// zhes gsungs pas so// sems nyid 'khor 'das su 'gyur tshul yang ji lta bu zhen/ sems 'khrul nas gzung 'dzin gyi rang bzhin ma shes par rmongs pas 'khor ba dang*/ de las bzlog pas myang 'das su 'gyur ba ste/ rgyud brtag gnyis las/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid// rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas ni// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ klu sgrub kyis/ gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa// de nyid spyang ba byas pa las// dag pa de nyid mya ngan 'das// zhes gsungs/ des na 'khor 'das skyon yon thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin rig pa dang ma rig pa'i 'jug ldog nyid kyi phyir mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi go 'phang bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi gnad don ni rang bzhin yongs su shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa'i lam gyi rim pa 'di kho na yin la/

gzhan bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim rtsa rlung sgom thabs sogs kyang gnas 'di'i 'jug ngogs tsam zhig pas/ dpa' bo'i rim pas rang byin rlabs pa yi// rim pa dag kyang thar pa'i lam ma yin// shin tu rnam dag rim pa gcig pu ni// thar pa'i slad du sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan// zhes gsungs/ des na zab mo'i don gnad mthar thug pa'i khrid rim 'di 'chad par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong ba bshad zin nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro de ston par byed de// de yang lam 'di nyid bsgom pa'i dang por sbyor ba med du mi rung ba rang babs rnam pa gsum mam/ dben pa gsum mam/ mi g.yo ba gsum zhes bya ba 'di ste/ chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa'i zhal snga nas/ lus ngag yid gsum bya ba btang*/ zhes gang gsungs pa ltar te/ lus kyi 'gro 'dug bya byed/ ngag gi smra brjod/ yid kyi rtog pa'i 'phro 'du ched spros der 'dzin sogs kyi dbang du mi gtong ba ni bya ba btang ba ste don dben gsum yin la/ 'di ni dpal rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ lus bsrangs rdo rje skyil krung bya// yid ni rtse gcig phyag rgya che// zhes gsungs pa'i dngos shugs las 'thon te/ lus bsrangs zhes pas skyil krung las gzhan pa'i lus gnad drug bstan pa ste/ lag pa dang sgal tshigs sogs lus kyi cha so sor rang rang gi cha nas bsrang ba'i don dang*/ rdo rje skyil krung ni lus gnad gzhan las gnad che ba'i phyir zur du bshad pa'am/ yang na lus bsrang dang rdor skyil dngos/ lhag ma rnams shugs kyis bstan par yang rung bas lus dben nam lus mi g.yo ba dang*/ yid ni rtse gcig sogs kyis sems dben nam sems mi g.yo ba bstan la// ngag mi g.yo ba ni de dag gi shugs las bstan te/

de'i dgongs pa'ang ngag ces pa ni rlung gdangs skad kyi nga ro 'char ba la byed pa de/ gang zhig smra bar 'dod pa ni kun slong*/ de ni sems sam shes pa/ de las rlung g.yos te lce mchu mgrin rkan sogs yi ge'i skye gnas dang 'phrad pa las skyes bu'i ngag 'byung bas na/ rig pa'i gzhung las/ yi ge'i kun slong shes pa las// skye la shes pas smra skye'o// zhes bshad de/ de'i phyir ngag ni brjod 'dod yid dang lce rkan sogs lus cha tshogs pa las 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyis lus yid 'ching na ngag shugs kyis 'ching pa la dgongs pas sam/ yang na lus byed bcings kyis 'ching na ngag steng 'og gi rlung 'chings/ des sems dbang po'i yul la 'phro mi thub par dwangs ma'i thig le kho na la rtse gcig tu gnas pas sems 'ching ba'ang yin te/ chos rje ras pas/ lus kyi gnas pas gnas pa ni// ngag gi gnas pas gnas pa yin// ngag gi gnas pas gnas pa ni// yid kyi gnas pas gnas pa yin// zhes dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal dbang rjes/ lus rang babs su gnas pas ngag rang babs su gnas/ ngag rang babs su gnas pas yid rang babs su gnas nas gnyug ma'i don 'char bar byed do// zhes sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig par gsungs pa'i don 'di las dben gsum ston pa'i go rim yang 'grub bo// de la lus dben par 'gyur ba lus gnad ji ltar bca' ba ni shin tu rmad byung gi rgyud las/ lus ni rdo rje skyil mo krung*// sgal tshigs rin chen rtsar la brgyus// mthong kha rgyun du yangs pa dang*// stong sko shin tu sba bar bya// lce ni yar rkan nyid du gtad// mnyam bzhag phyag rgya lte 'og btsir// zhes gsung pa ltar rkang pa g.yas steng du bton pa'i rdo rje skyil krung bcas/ sgal tshigs rin po che'i dong rtse rtsar la brgyus pa ltar bsrangs/ mthong kha rgyun tu yangs par bya ba ni thal gong phyir dgye bas 'grub/ stong sko spa ba ni og skos ol mdud non tsam du mgrin pa gug pa/

lce rtse bzlog ste ya rkan la gtad cing mchu so la yid tsam bar yod par bya/ lag pa'i mthe bong gis srin lag gi rtsa ba mnan te brtsegs pa g.yon 'og tu 'ong ba'i mnyam bzhag ste byed 'ching drug dang*/ bdun pa ni spyir rig pa dbang pos bsgyur/ khyad par mig gis bsgyur bas mig mi 'dzum zhing mi 'gul bar gnya' shing gang tsam gyi thad du blta ba ste/ spyod lam gnya' shing gang tsam blta// zhes dang*// sdud pa las kyang*/ gnya' shing gang tsam blta zhing 'gro la sems 'khrul med// ces dang*/ do ha las/ mig ni mi 'dzum sems 'gags na// rlung 'gog pa ni dpal ldan bla mas rtogs// zhes gsungs/ kha gcig tu mchu dang so rang lugs su 'jog par bshad pa yod kyang gong du bshad pa ltar legs la/ ka mā shi la'i sgom rim gnyis su ni de dag gi thog tu dbugs phyi nang gang du rgyu ba la/ sgra can dang*/ rdam pa dang*/ rgod bag tu mi btang zhing phar rgyu tshur rgyu mi tshor bar dal bus 'bad med du 'jug par bya ba ste/ lus kyi kun spyod brgyad du bshad do// gnad thabs de dag ci rigs su bstan pa/ rdo rje 'phreng bar/ sgrub po bde ba'i stan 'dug ste// mig ni sna rtser gtad byas nas// sna mthong lta ba'i tshad du zhog /phrag dpung mnyam la lce rkan sbyar// so dang mchu ni bde bar bzhag /dang*/ rdo rje skyil krung legs gnas shing*// de ltar phyag rgya dang ldan pa// zhes dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ 'du 'dzi med pa'i gnas gtsang ma// der ni skyil krung bca' bar bya// ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub snying por bzhugs pa bzhin// mig btsum po la sor bzhag ste/ lus bsrang phyag rgya byas nas ni/ zhes dang*/ slob dpon dpag med rdo rjes/ bde ba'i stan gnas rdo rje skyil krung dang*// lag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa'i phyag rgya can// lus bsrangs nas ni mgrin pa dgug pa dang*// zhes sogs bshad cing*/

nā ro zhabs kyis/ de la lus kyi gnad bshad pa// rin chen rtsar la brgyus pa ltar// shin tu bsrangs la dgug par bya// li khri bzhin du khong sgrim bya// rgya mdud lta bu'i tshul du gnas// 'phel ka shin tu bskyed par bya// mnyam bzhag rgya yis btsir byas shing*// zhes gsungs/ mig gi lta stangs sna rtser blta ba dang*/ gnya' shing gang tsam du blta ba ni mi 'gal te/ phyi ma'i shugs las snga ma thon pa'o// 'di la nyan thos zhi ba'i lta stangs zhes kyang bya ste/ nyan thos zhi ba thur du lta zhes pas so// lus gnad lta stangs de ltar byas pa'i phan yon ni/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos/ lus gnad bsam gtan gyi chos lnga dang ldan pas/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung rang sar dag nas nyon mongs pa lnga dag par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs la/ rlung dag tshul yang dbu mar zin pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas te/ skyil krung gis thur sel gyi rlung zin/ mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya lte 'og tu btsir bas me mnyam gyi rlung*/ sgal tshigs bsrangs pa dang dang kha dgye bas khyab byed/ mgrin pa gug pa dang lce ya rkan la gtad pas gyen rgyu/ lta stangs kyi srog 'dzin gyi rlung dbu mar tshud pa'am/ yang na sgal tshigs bsrangs nas lus bsgrims pas khyab byed/ dpung pa dang gru mo ma gug par phrag pa thad kar brgyang bas srog 'dzin/ lta stangs mi g.yo bar byas pas yan lag gi rlung rnams zin par yang bshad la/ spyir rtsa ba'i rlung rnams zin pas yan lag gi rlung rnams shugs kyis zin par 'gyur ba'ang yin no// de la dbang rnon 'ga' zhig lus gnad tsam gyis grol ba yod pas/ mtshan brjod dang shin tu rmad byung gi rgyud tshig mthun par/ rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes gsungs pa ltar byed chings kyi stobs kyis rlung bcu rang mal du 'ching nas dbu mar dngos su 'bab pa dang*/ der brtan pa dang thim pa mthar thug pa'i bar gyis lam gyi mngon rtogs rdzogs pas sangs rgya ba yod la/

de la dgongs nas khyad chos bsre 'phor lus gnad tsam gyis grol ba gsungs shing*/ 'dul ba lung gi gtam rgyud du/ spre'us bstan pa'i lus gnad kyis drang srong lnga brgya rang sangs rgyas lnga brgyar gyur tshul bshad pa'ang 'di dang phyogs mthun zhing*/ de ltar gyi tshe na ngag rang bab man gyi khrid tshul yang ched du mi dgos/ dbang po 'bring man la lus gnad 'dis rlung bcu dbu mar kha phyogs pas 'jug par brtsom pa la zhugs pa'i tha snyad dang*/ de nyid dngos su 'jug pa man sgrub pa'i don du ngag dben man chad la 'jug pa'o// gzhan yang gnas skabs kyi yon tan rtsa rlung byang chub kyi sems rnams rang sar gnas shing brtan par byed/ de la brten nas lus kyi 'byung ba cha snyoms shing zo mdog bzang la nyan sa las ni/ lus kyi spyod lam des shin sbyangs myur du skye ba dang*/ dus yun ring mor 'da' bar byed nus shing*/ lus shin tu ngal bar mi 'gyur ba dang*/ spyod lam des mu stegs pa dang phas kyi rgol ba dag las khyad par du gyur pa dang*/ spyod lam des 'dug pa mthong na shin tu dang ba skye ba dang*// spyod lam de sangs rgyas dang de'i nyan thos rnams kyis mdzad pas na brten par bya bar bshad do// lus gnad 'chol ba'i skyon ni/ g.yas su yo na dang por gsal yang gzung ba'i rnam rtog mang*/ g.yon du yo na dang por bde yang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa mang*/ dgur na dang por gsal ngar che yang phyis sems 'tshub par 'gyur// dgye na dang por dwangs shing gu yangs kyang phyis yengs cha che/ lta stangs 'gyur na 'jug shes langs nas rnam rtog mang po 'phro ba'i skyon 'byung bar bshad do// byed 'ching 'di rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i bzhugs stangs 'dra bas dang*/ lhag par gzugs phung gi chos nyid dam rang bzhin rnam snang du bzhugs par/ rdor phreng gi rgyud las/ dang po sku yi rdo rje ni// gzugs phung la ni yang dag bzhugs// zhes gsungs pa'i gnas lugs mngon du byed pa'i nges pas kyang rnam snang gi chos zhes bya la byed 'ching kyi cha shas nas bgrang pas bdun no// gzhan sems skyil lus bsrangs me thabs drug chings sogs kyang lus gnad kyi khyad par dang lus dag byed kyang yin mod kyi/

'dir bzung ba tsam du gzugs phung dag sgrub kyi yon tan phul du byung ba'ang ma yin zhing*/ rnam snang gi chos su bshad tshod kyang med pa'i phyir der mi brjod mod/ rgyun du rdor skyil ma nus na sems skyil byas te gnad gzhan rnams snga ma ltar bya ba'ang rung ngo*// tshul de lta bu'i lus kyi gnad thabs skyon dang bral ba la nan tan gyis 'bad dgos te/ sems gnas par 'dod na lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gcun zhes rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char ba zhes gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa dang*/ jo bo nā ro pas// lus kyi gnad thabs sgom pa'i gnad// ces gsungs/ de bas lus kyi de nyid shes na sems kyi de nyid rtogs par 'gyur la/ de las gzhan du min pas/ sam+bu ṭar/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gi ni cho gas kyang*// lus kyi de nyid ma shes na// de dag thams cad 'bras bu med// ces gsungs te/ lus kyi de nyid rtsa rlung thig gsum gyi byed las rten 'brel sogs dang*/ lus kyi rang bzhin sku rdo rjer dag pa'i nges pa dang*/ lus la gnad du bsnun pas sems nyid rtogs par 'gyur ba'i gnad rig pa sogs yin la/ kha cig rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin na lus la gnad du bsnun dgos kyang*/ phyag rgya chen por grags pa la de med pas de ni sngags lam mthar thug min zhes 'dod pa yang skabs don 'di tsam gyis khegs pa yin te/ rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun thabs 'di ltar bstan pas so// yang de tsam gyi lus gnad mdor yang bshad pas de dag tu yang rdo rje'i lus la gnad bsnun yod par 'gyur ro zhe na/ de dag tu lus gnad tsam yod kyang lus kyi de nyid shes nas sam/ de'i ched du gnad bsnun mi byed pas rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa med la/ 'dir ni dag bya dag byed dag 'bras sogs kyi nges pa la brten pas te/ dag bya gzugs phung ngam lus kyi chos/

dag byed rnam snang chos bdun/ dag tshul rlung zhugs gnas thim pa'i rim gyis/ dag 'bras rnam snang gi go 'phang ngo*// gnyis pa ngag dben ni/ spyir smra ba la dga' ba ni nyes pa'i sgo dang*/ nyon mongs pa thams cad skye ba'i gzhir gyur pas na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang smra ba la dga' ba'i nyes pa brgyad cu rtsa gnyis sam nyi shu rtsa bdun du gsungs la/ rgyud sde kun nas sngags kyi nus pa 'phrog pa'i dgag byas kyang smra bcad bya ba dang*/ sngags bzlas kyi mchog kyang smra bcad rang babs yin par/ slob dpon rdo rje gdan pas/ ā li kā li mnyam byas pa'i// mi g.yo mi smra bzlas pa'i mchog /ces gsungs/ de la dug gsum dag pa'i mtshon par rlung ro lan gsum bsal nas phal gyi long gtam sogs lta ci/ re zhig kha ton bzlas brjod sogs kyang mi bya bar/ smra bcad du gnas dgos te/ rdo rje gdan bzhi las/ rlung dang ngag ni g.yo med pa// 'di yis bsam gtan 'bras bu 'grub// ces dang*/ rdor 'phreng las/ dbugs ni 'byung rngub glod nas ni// zhes gsungs/ 'di dag gi skabs su rje btsun gyis/ phyag rgya chen po sgom dus su// lus ngag dge sbyor ma brtson zhig /mi rtog ye shes yal nyen yod// ces dang*/ gu ru pad+mas/ chos kun rtsa ba rang gi sems nyid de// nang du mnyam par bzhag pas don rtogs 'gyur// lus ngag dge sbyor tsam gyi so na med// des na gcig pur rang sems blta bar bya// zhes dang*/ jo bo rjes/ gcig tu mnyam bzhag sems brtan na// lus ngag dge sbyor gtsor mi bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar sgrub la/ kha cig ma yengs tsam gyi ngang nas lus ngag gi dge sbyor sgrub dgos pas/ bya cha chos spyod sogs 'bol mi rigs snyam na yang*/ las dang po pa'i skabs 'dir de dag 'phrugs pa dka' zhing cung zad 'phrugs pa ltar snang yang sgom yar bskyed 'byung ba'i gegs su 'gro ba dang*/ gnas cha cung zad yod pa la sgom yal rkyen du 'gro ba sogs mang bas dus mtshams shes pa gal che'o// gsum pa sems dben ni/

lus gnad dang ngag gnad de dag dang ldan pas/ dpal til+li pa'i chos drug gam bzhag thabs drug tu grags pa ltar nyams su len pa ste/ de nyid kyis/ mi mno mi bsam mi dpyad cing*// mi sgom mi sems rang bab bzhag /ces gsungs/ de la mi mno zhes pa ni/ 'das pa'i don gyi rtog pa'i rjes su mi 'brang ba ste/ 'brang na de ji srid du yid g.yeng bar 'gyur bas so// mi bsam zhes pa/ da lta'i sems snang la bzo bcos dang rtsis gdab mi byed pa ste/ byas na mnyam par bzhag rgyu'i sems rkyen dbang du 'chor bas so// mi sems zhes pa/ ma 'ongs pa na bya byed kyi rtog pa sngon mi bsu ba ste/ bsus na shes pa de'i yul la g.yo zhing mi brtan par 'gyur bas so// de ltar du sa ra has kyang*/ bsams dang bsam bya thams cad yongs su dor nas su// ji ltar bu chung lhug par gnas pa bzhin// bla ma'i lung la bsgrims te gus 'bad na// lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med// ces gsungs/ de'i sgrims te gus 'bad sogs kyi don ni/ bla ma'i man ngag gam lung las byung ba'i don la sgrims shing gus par 'bad pa ste brtson 'grus bskyed pa'i don yin la/ brtson rgyu dngos bsams dang bsam bya dor ba de la'o// gzhan yang de nyid kyis/ phyi dang nang du blta ba med pa'i sems de ni// gang gis mi bsam gang la yang ni sems ma yin// rang bzhin gnas pa rdo rje rtse mo glu blangs pa// zhes dang*/ sha wa ras/ 'di ltar dus gsum rnam pa thams cad du// yid la byar med mtha' bral gnyug ma'i ngang*// de nyid skyong la sgom zhes tha snyad bzhag /ces so// mi sgom zhes pa/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med sogs blo yi yul du gyur pa gang yang mi sgom pa ste/ bsgoms na gzung 'dzin gyi yid byed du 'gyur bas so// de ltar yang bram ze chen pos/ kye ma rang bzhin bral ba'i de nyid sgom du yod ma zer// gal te bsgom par bya dang sgom byed gnyis rtog na// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i yid kyis byang chub sems spangs nas// skyes bu de yis rang gis rang la sdig pa byas// zhes so// mi dpyad ces pa/

de ltar spros pa zhi ba'i ngang de la slar blos brtag dpyad mi bya ba ste/ byas na slar blo rtog gis gnyis snang dang mtshan 'dzin bskyed pas so// bram ze chen pos/ mtha' yis ma gos dri ma med pa'i snying po ni// rang bzhin gdod nas dag pas kun gyis dpyad bya min// gal te dpyad na dug sprul gtses pa kho nar zad// ces so// rang babs bzhag ces pa/ sems kyi rang bzhin nam 'dug tshul ji ltar yod pa de ga ltar ma bcos par 'jog pa ste/ de min gnas lugs kyi don blos byas kyis bslad par 'gyur bas so// mda' bsnun zhabs kyis/ rang bzhin bzhag pa ji lta bu nyid de lta nyid// 'bras bu thogs pa med pa gdod nas rang la gnas// zhes dang*/ rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bsam gtan dag gis mi bslad de// bdag nyid bde la gnas shing gdung bar ma byed cig /ces dang*/ sha wa ras/ rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bcos mi dgos// ma bzung ma btang rang ga nyid du zhog /ces so// de lta bu'i bzhag thabs rnams la sems ngo rtse gcig tu skyong tshul gyi gnad phal cher 'dus pas de ltar nan tan du skyong bar bya la/ gzhan yang rje sgam po pa'i tshogs chos las/ ngo bo rang gi sems la blta na/ sems de glod la bzhag so mar bzhag rang gar bzhag /lhug par bzhag go zhes bzhag thabs bzhir gsungs pa sogs yod kyang*/ phal cher phan tshun du 'du zhing mthun par 'gyur la// de kun kyang ma yengs pa tsam du 'du zhing tshang bas/ zla 'od gzhon nus/ ma yengs pa ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ ma yengs pa ni dge ba'i bshes dang gnyen /ma yengs pa ni gdams pa kun gyi gtso// zhes dang*/ ma yengs rgyun gyi dran pa 'di// dus gsum sangs rgyas gzhung lam yin// zhes gsungs shing*/ klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ dbang phyug lus gtogs dran pa bde gshegs kyi// bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam du nye bar bstan// de la sgrims te mngon par bsrung bgyi zhing*// dran pa nyams pas chos kun 'jig par 'gyur// zhes gsungs/

lung phyi ma 'di'i don/ dbang phyug ces/ rgyal po bde spyod bzang po la slob dpon gyis bod par mdzad nas/ lus 'greng ba dang 'dug pa sogs kyi gnas skabs thams cad la rnam par dpyod pa ni lus su gtogs pa'i dran pa ste/ de ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mo// de yang mdo las/ dge slong dag sems can rnams rnam par dag par byed pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ yid mi bde bas yang dag pa 'da' bar byed pa dang*/ rigs pa'i chos rtogs par byed pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa mngon sum du byed pa'i lam ni 'di lta ste lus su gtogs pa'i dran pa yin no// zhes so// dran pa de ni shin tu gal che ba'i phyir/ de ni sgrims nas mngon par bsrungs bgyi ste/ dran pa 'di nyid phyogs re ba ma yin gyi/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar 'jug pa'i lam po che lta bu'am/ thams cad kyi rten lus lta bu yin pas na lus su gtogs pa'i dran pa'o// spyir dran pa zhes pa la'ang*/ 'das pa la blta ba'i dran pa dang*/ don snga phyi sbyar nas 'dzin pa'i dran pa/ yul nges kyi dran pa khyad par can sogs dbye ba 'ga' zhig las/ dang po ni/ sngon gyi gnas skabs dang*/ yul rnams dran lam du byas nas mngon par zhen pa ste/ dbu ma bzhi brgya par/ mthong zin dngos po mi snang zhing*// slar yang sems kyis min des na// dran pa shes bya log pa yi// don la rtog pa kho na 'byung*// zhes so// gnyis pa de ni tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ dbang po 'khrul pa las gzhan du// dbang po rnams ni sbyor byed pa// tha dad mtshon med 'khrul pa can// dran yin de yang rnam rtog can// zhes bshad pa de yin la/ yul nges kyi dran pa ni dran pa khyad par can te/ mngon pa kun las btus pa las/ dran pa gang zhe na/ 'dris pa'i dngos po la sems brjed pa med pa ste/ sems rnam par mi g.yeng ba'i las can no// zhes 'byung ba de yin la/

dang po gnyis ni zhi gnas kyi tshe dgag par bya ba ste/ sems byung mang po'i nang tshan/ gnyis pa ni bsten par bya ba'i dran pa ste dran pa nyer bzhag gi dran pa'o// 'di la yul gyi khyad par sngar 'dris shing nges par byas pa'i dngos po la dmigs rten bcas pa ste/ ma 'dris pa'i yul la ni dran pa mi 'dod pas so// 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par gzhan gyis 'dris pa dang rang gis de la rtog pa bcug na/ dmigs rten de ni 'di 'dra ba yin no// zhes dran nus tsam la mi bya yi/ dmigs pa nges pa'i nges shes kyi 'dzin stangs de rgyun brtan par byed pa la bya ste/ 'dzin stangs de las gzhan du yengs na dran pa nyams pa zhes bya bas so// des na sems gang la gtad pa'i dmigs pa sna re dran nas dmigs pa'i blo de'i rgyun skyong ba ni dran pa brten pa zhes bya'o// byed las kyi khyad par ni de ltar bskyangs pas yid dmigs pa gang gtad las gzhan du rnam par g.yeng bar mi byed pa'o// yang byang chub yan lag gi dran pa ni/ chos yang dag par bsdu ba'i mdor/ de la dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi lam gang zhe na/ dran pa gang gis chos rnams rtogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ chos rnams so sor rtogs pa dang*/ chos rnams la dpyod pa dang*/ chos rnams la kun tu 'gro ba dang*/ chos rnams la bsam pa dang*/ chos la rjes su rtogs pa ste/ dran pa des chos kyi rang bzhin mtshan nyid rtogs par 'gyur ro// chos rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong ste/ de ltar gang gis de ltar brtag cing rtogs pa 'di ni dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ces bya'o// zhes so// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa'i dran pa ni/ blo gros mi zad par bstan pa'i mdor/ de la yang dag pa'i dran pa gang zhe na/ dran pa gang shin tu nye bar bzhag pa dang*/ mi sgul ba dang*/ drang ba dang*/ gya gyu med pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i skyon gyi nyes dmigs blta ba dang*/

mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba'i lam du 'dren pa ste/ dran pa dang*/ gzhungs pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i lam mi brjed pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i dran pa zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs pa de'o// de la sogs pa byang phyogs kyi dran pa'i na rim dang 'dir gzung dran pa'i na rim don cig ste/ byang phyogs lam du spyod cing 'dir yang lam lngas bsgrod pas te/ de yang tshogs lam chung ngu na lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa/ tshor ba/ sems/ chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ 'bring po na sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed/ skyes pa spong ba/ dge ba ma skyes pa bskyed/ skyes pa 'phel bar byed pa bzhi/ tshogs lam chen po na 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ brtson 'grus kyi/ spyod pa'i/ sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ sbyor lam drod dang*/ rtse mor/ dad pa'i dbang po/ brtson 'grus kyi/ dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi/ shes rab kyi dbang po ste dbang po lnga/ bzod pa dang chos mchog tu/ dad pa'i stobs/ brtson 'grus dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab kyi stobs te stobs lnga/ mthong lam du dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa dang*/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ste byang chub yan lag bdun/ sgom lam du yang dag pa'i lta ba/ yang dag pa'i rtogs pa/ yang dag pa'i ngag /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba/ yang dag pa'i dran pa/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad rnams yod la/ des na dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi'i dran pa rtse gcig skabs te sngon 'gro tshogs lam/ drod rtse bzod pa chos mchog ste sbyor lam bzhir dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga'i/ dran pa'i dbang po dang*/ dran pa'i stobs/ spros bral mthong lam du byang chub yan lag bdun gyi dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag

/ro gcig sgom lam gyi skabs su 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi yang dag pa'i dran pa rnam rim bzhin 'byor la/ de ltar sbyor ba yang mnyam med sgam po pa'i gsungs dang bstun nas so// sems 'grel la sogs mang por ni 'dra min gzhan yang yod cing*/ rnal 'byor bzhi po rang la rim bzhin dran pa/ dran med/ skye med/ blo 'das zhes gsungs mod kyang*/ don gzung dran dang yang dag gi dran pa gnyis su 'du la/ de gnyis kyi khongs su byang phyogs kyi dran pa dag kyang 'du bas/ dbye bsdu dang ming gi rnam grangs tsam las don du rnam dbyer med la yang dag gi dran pa de nyid rnam par thar pa bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi dran par yang bstan te/ mtshan brjod 'grel chen du/ dran pa'i ngo bo stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i tshul can/ dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin brgya stong gi bdag por gyur pas na/ dran pa bzhi po ting 'dzin rgyal// zhes bya'o// zhes 'byung*/ mdor na bka' brgyud gong mas/ lam rnams kun gyi rtsa ba dran pa yin// zhes dang*/ nyams len thams cad dran par gcig /ces dang*/ dran pa yengs pa med la bya// zhes dang*/ ma yengs pa'i 'jog tshul gcig pu la// theg gsum gyi byang chub so sor ston// zhes gsungs/ de bas dkar chos mtha' dag gi rtsa ba dang snying po dran pa yengs med kho na nyid kyang chos smra ba phal cher de las byol stabs su 'chad cing*/ 'ga' zhig gnas skabs phyogs rer rtsis su byed pa tsam du zad la/ yin lugs 'gag tu dril nas gsung ba ni bka' brgyud sangs rgyas phreng bar nges pas de dag gi dgongs don phyogs tsam go bar bya ba la/ 'dir cung zad spros pa'ang byas so// de ltar dben gsum gyi don mdor dril na/ til+li pas/ lus kyi bya ba thong la rnal mar zhog /ngag gi smra brjod ma mang brag cha bzhin// yid la mi bsam la zla'i chos la ltos// zhes gsungs/

des na spros bcas bya rtsol las 'das pa spros med dben gsum gyi ngang du gnas pa las don chen thob par 'gyur te/ paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin po ches/ gang du'ang mchog gi go 'phang la// yid gcig pa yis bsam byed na// de las dngos grub rnyed 'gyur te// bya mang rtsom la 'bras bu ci// zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas dkri ba yin pas/ de la mdo dang rgyud sde las tshul 'di nyid ji ltar gsungs pa phyogs tsam zhig bshad par bya'o// de yang mdo sde lang gshegs las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blo gros chen po chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams rnal 'byor chen po'i rnal 'byor can du 'gyur ro// bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rang gis sems snang ba rnam par bsgom pa dang*/ skye ba dang gnas pa dang 'jig pa'i lta ba rnam par spong ba dang*/ phyi rol gyi dngos po dngos po med par rtogs pa dang*/ 'phags pa so so rang gi ye shes khong du chud par mos pa yin te/ blo gros chen po chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams rnal 'byor chen po'i rnal 'byor can du 'gyur ro// zhes pas rnal 'byor bzhi bstan la/ de yang so sor phye nas bshad na/ sems snang ba rnam par sgom pas rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bstan te/ de nyid du/ blo gros chen po de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rang gi sems snang ba rnam par sgom pa la mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'di ltar khams gsum 'di ni rang gi sems tsam ste/ bdag dang bdag gi dang bral ba g.yo med pa blang ba dang dor ba dang bral ba/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi spros pa'i gnas ngan len gyi bag chags la mngon par zhen pas bgos pa/ khams gsum gyi gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs la nye bar spyod pas 'brel ba/

lus dang longs spyod dang gnas dang 'gro bar rnam par rtog pa'i rjes su song bar snang ngo zhes rab tu rtog ste/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor don mthun pa'i phyir ro// skye ba dang gnas pa dang 'jig pa'i lta ba rnam par spong bas spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bstan te/ de nyid las/ blo gros chen po ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skye ba dang*/ gnas pa dang 'jig pa'i lta ba rnam par spangs pa yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dngos po thams cad ni sgyu ma dang rmi lam gyi gzugs skye ba dang 'dra bar bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis ka med pa'i phyir mi skye ste/ rang gi sems snang ba tsam gyi rjes su 'brang ba dang phyi rol gyi dngos po med par mthong ngo*// dngos po med par mthong bas rnam par shes pa rnams 'jug pa med pa dang*/ rkyen rnams kyang phung po dang spungs pa med par mthong nas khams gsum rnam par rtog pa'i rkyen las 'byung bar mthong bas phyi nang gi chos thams cad mi dmigs shing*/ rang bzhin med pa rjes su mthong ba'i phyir/ skye ba'i lta ba rnam par log nas sgyu ma la sogs pa'i chos kyi rang bzhin du rjes su rtogs pas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob ste/ zhes pa dang spros bral gyi rnal 'byor don mthun pa'i phyir ro// phyi rol gyi dngos po dngos po med par rab tu rtogs pa la mkhas pas ro gcig gi rnal 'byor bstan te/ de nyid du/ blo gros chen po de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyi rol gyi dngos po dngos po med par rtogs pa la mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dngos po thams cad ni smig rgyu dang rmi lam dang skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu'o// dngos po thams cad thog ma med pa'i dus kyi spros pa'i gnas ngan len gyi rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags rnam pa sna tshogs la mngon par zhen pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin te/

rang bzhin med pa'o// zhes yang dag par mthong ba'i byang chub sems dpa' zhes pa dang ro gcig gi rnal 'byor don mthun pa'i phyir ro// 'phags pa so so rang rig gi ye shes khong du chud par mos pas sgom med kyi rnal 'byor bstan te/ de nyid du/ blo gros chen po ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa so so rang gi ye shes khong du chud par mos pa yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob nas sa brgyad pa la gnas te/ sems dang yid dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang chos lnga dang rang bzhin dang bdag med pa gnyis rtogs pa rab tu gyur pa khong du chud pa'i phyir yid kyi lus kyang rab tu thob bo// zhes pa dang sgom med kyi rnal 'byor don mthun pa'i phyir ro// de bzhin du lang gshegs las/ sems tsam la ni brten nas su// phyir rol don la mi brtag go /de bzhin nyid kyi dmigs gnas nas// sems tsam las kyang 'da' bar bya// sems tsam las ni 'das nas su// snang ba med la gnas par bya// snang med gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa// de yis theg pa chen po mthong*// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ de'i don sgom rim du bshad pa dang*/ sher phyin man ngag tu bshad pa rnams kyang rnal 'byor bzhi dang don mthun no// rgyud sde las ji ltar gsungs pa ni/ dpal kye rdo rjer/ skye med rim pa'i phyogs la ni// 'di ltar lhan cig skyes rnam bzhi// zhes gsungs la/ de don rgyun chags su gtan la phab pa/ sdom 'byung gi le'u gsum par/ de bzhin mkha' mnyam stong pa nyid// sna tshogs de bzhin nyid bdag med// thabs ni snying rje'i stobs yin te// zung du 'jug pa rnam rtog bral// dkyil 'khor snying po mchog yin no// zhes pas gtan la 'bebs pa gzhi phyag rgya chen po gsungs/ de nas 'bebs byed/ de ma thag tu/ rnam par mi rtog sbyor bsams kyang*// de tshe mi rtog bsam mi khyab// de yang rnam pa kun gyi mchog

/ces rtse gcig gsungs la/ rtse gcig dang rnam par mi rtog pa ming gi rnam grangs pa'o// de nas/ bde ba'i dbang po rnam pa med// de nyid dngos dang dngos min bdag /rtag tu srid pa 'byung bar mdzad// sna tshogs spros pa'i rtog pa med// rtag tu 'byung ba bde ba che// skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin gyis// de las skye ba yang dag 'byung*// bem po min phyir bdag nyid rig /mi shes rnam par mi mthong bas// gzugs med gang du'ang mi gnas shing*// 'gyur ba med cing brtan pa'o// kun rdzob skye ba 'byung bas na// med pa min phyir dngos med min// zhes pas spros bral/ de nas/ lhan cig skyes dga'i rang dngos su// chos rnams thams cad lhan cig skyes// bdag byin rlabs pa rang byung ba// mi shigs 'jig pa med pa ste// skye ba med pa'i ro myong pas// bsgom pa yang ni de nyid de// stong nyid so sor rtogs pas na// bsam gtan shes rab tu yang 'gyur// zhes pas ro gcig de nas/ chos kun yongs su shes pa yin// bsgom pa de nyid bsgom med pa'o// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bde ba che// phyag rgya chen po mchog de bzhin// de nyid chos la 'jug pa'i phyir// de rnams dbye ba rab bstan la// bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis// gsal bar 'gyur gyis gzhan du min// zhes sgom med kyi rnal 'byor bstan la/ le'u gsum par/ de bas ye shes 'byung ba yi// sogs kyis slar yang rgyas bshad dang*/ sam+bu ṭar yang*/ chos dbyings shin tu mnyam pa nyid// ces sogs kyis mthar chags su bstan la/ mdo rgyud gzhan nas phyogs re bstan pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab po// dpal sa ra has rtse mo do har/ sems nyid kun tu 'od gsal ba'o// zhes pa yin gyi rtse gcig de nas/ yod pa ma yin med ma yin// rig pas grub bam yin no'i bar gyi spros bral/ ma 'das dbyer med ro gcig la// gcig tu bzhag par bya ba'ang med// ces pa'i bar gyi ro gcig

dwangs ma de nyid ma slad pa'i// kho na nyid ni gar ma g.yos zhes pa man gyis sgom med bstan no// de las 'dir ni rtse gcig zhi gnas dang*/ spros bral lhag mthong gi khrid du mdzad nas ston pas/ de dag la thun mong gi nyams len zhes mdo lam gyi dngos bstan dang*/ thun mong du gyur pa shas che bas dang*/ rnal 'byor lhag ma gnyis ni mdo phyogs kyi dngos bstan las khyad par du 'gyur ba sngags bla na med pa'i bstan don shas che ba'i phyir thun mong ma yin pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa'o// de ltar na gong du rnal 'byor phyi ma gnyis kyang mdo nas bstan tshul byung ba dang 'gal lam snyam na/ mdo phyogs nas kyang de de'i tha snyad dang nyams len spyi spom tsam bstan yang zhib chags khrigs rim lag tu blang bde ma sbas mtha' rgyas su bstan pa med pas thun mong ma yin pa'i sa mtshams 'dzin gyi/ gzhan mdo sngags mdor bstan rgyas bshad yin pa'i phyir sngags su gang zhig bstan don de'i thob thang sa khongs tsam re mdor yang yod pa yin no// de'i thun mong ba rang ston tshul gyi go rim kyang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye// dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*// rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir// de dag rim pas gnas pa yin// zhes phar phyin drug snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma skye ba dang*/ rgyu mtshan snga ma dman pa dang phyi ma mchog tu gyur pa bzhin rags pa dang phra ba'i dbang gis kyang yin par gsungs la/ bshes spring las kyang*/ bsam gtan med par yang ni shes rab med// ces dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms pa shes byas nas// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni// zhes sogs 'byung ba dang sgo mthun par/ sgom gyi rtsa ba zhi gnas kyi nyams btsal nas rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ gnas 'gyu'i rtsa ba dpyad nas lhag mthong ngos bzung ste spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa gnyis kyi rim pas 'chad pa'i/

'chad gzhi zhi lhag gi ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba dag kyang 'dir zhar gyis brjod par bya ste/ de gnyis kyi ngo bo ni/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa las/ de gcig pu dben par 'dug ste nang du yang dag bzhag nas/ ji ltar legs par bsams pa'i chos de dag nyid yid la byed cing*/ sems can gang gis yid la byed pa'i sems de nang du rgyun chags su yid la byed pas yid la byed do// de ltar zhugs shing de la lan mang du gnas pa de la/ lus shin tu sbyangs pa dang*/ sems shin tu sbyangs pa de thob nas de nyid la gnas te sems kyi rnam pa spangs nas/ ji ltar legs par bsam pa'i chos de dag nyid nang du ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gzugs brnyan du so sor rtog par byed mos par byed do// de ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gzugs brnyan de dag las shes bya'i don de rnam par 'byed pa dang lta ba rnam par rtogs pa gang yin pa de ni lhag mthong zhes bya ste/ zhes dang*/ dkon mchog sprin las/ zhi gnas ni sems rtse gcig pa'o// lhag mthong ni yang dag par so sor rtog pa'o// zhes dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ chos kyi ming ni sdom pa'ang 'di// zhi gnas lam du shes par bya// lhag mthong lam ni 'di don rnams// rnam par dpyod par shes par bya// zhes dang*/ yang dag gnas pa la brten nas// sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang*// chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong yin// zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel bar slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas sems la sems 'jog pa'i phyir dang*/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir go rim bzhin du zhi gnas dang lhag mthong yin par rig par bya yi/ ting nge 'dzin med par ni ma yin te/ 'di ni zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi mtshan nyid yin no// zhes bshad de/ spyir btang tsam du ni dmigs pa'i yul gang yang rung ba la sems gtad nas/

sems de gzhan du mi yengs par rtse gcig tu gnas pa zhi gnas dang*/ shes par bya ba'i don de nyid la so sor rnam par rtog pa'i tshul gyis 'byed cing dpyod pa'i sems lhag mthong du gsal bar gsungs shing*/ de yang dang por dmigs pa la sems 'jog pa dang bsdus te 'jog dgos pa nas mthar rgyud gcig tu byed pa dang mnyam par 'jog pa'i bar thams cad zhi gnas dang*/ shes bya'i don de nyid kyi mtshan ma yid la byed cing 'byed pa nas mthar rgyas par mkhas pa dang shes rab kyi ngang gis 'jug pa'i bar thams cad lhag mthong du bshad de/ byang sa las/ brjod du med pa'i dngos po tsam dang*/ don tsam gyi dmigs pa la sems nges par gtad nas/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba dang sems yongs su g.yeng ba thams cad dang bral ba'i 'du shes yid la byed pas dmigs pa thams cad la mos pa na/ nang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan ma rnams la sems 'jog pa dang*/ bsdus te 'jog pa nas/ rgyas par rgyud gcig tu byed pa dang ting nge 'dzin du byed pa'i bar 'di ni zhi gnas zhes bya'o// lhag mthong gang zhe na/ zhi gnas yongs su bsgom pa'i yid la byed pa de nyid kyis/ ji ltar bsam pa'i chos de dag nyid kyi mtshan ma yid la byed cing 'byed pa dang rab tu rnam par 'byed pa dang chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa nas/ rgyas par mkhas pa dang shes rab kyis 'jug pa'i bar gang yin pa 'di ni lhag mthong zhes bya'o// zhes so// nges tshig ni sgra sbyor bam po gnyis par/ sam tha zhes bya ba/ same bas+thi te sa ma thaḥzhes bya ste/ sam ni zhi ba/ s+tha ni gnas pa ste/ gzugs la sogs pa yul gyis sems g.yeng ba zhi bar byas nas bsam gtan dang gang sgom pa de la sems rtse gcig tu zhugs pa'i ming yin pas na zhi gnas zhes bya zhes dang*/ bi pāṃ sh+ya na zhes bya ba pi ni bi she ṣa ste khyad par ram lhag pa/ pa sh+ya na mthong ba'am lta ba la bya/ spyir na shes rab kyis dngos po'i rang bzhin lhag par rtogs pa'i ming yin pas lhag mthong zhes bya/

zhes 'byung ste/ mdor na sems nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa zhi zhing dge ba'i ngor rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni zhi gnas dang*/ mthong ba dang bral ba'i don ji bzhin lhag ger mthong ba ni mthong ba rnams kyi nang nas lhag par mthong ba ste lhag mthong zhes bya la/ rnam par rtog pa'ang rags pa dang phra ba gnyis kyi rags pa ni yid kyi yul la rtog pa tsam dang*/ phra ba ni slar yang rtog bde la dpyod par byed pa ste/ mdzod las/ rtog dang dpyod pa rtsing zhib nyid// ces bshad mod/ 'dir man ngag gi dbang du na yul la 'jug pa'i rtog dpyod mngon gyur du tshor ba de rags pa dang*/ yul la dngos su 'jug pa mi tshor ba de phra bar bzhed pa yin no// zhi lhag gi dbye ba las/ zhi gnas kyi dbye ba ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhi gnas gnyis dang*/ byed las kyi sgo nas mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i zhi gnas sogs gsum yod kyang*/ grags che ba la thabs kyi sgo nas sems rnam pa dgur 'byed de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa la ni sems gtad nas// de rgyun rnam par g.yeng mi bya/ zhes sogs kyi 'grel par/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi po 'dis ni sems gnas pa rnam pa dgus gnas pa'i thabs bstan te/ rnam pa dgu ni/ sems 'jog par byed/ kun tu 'jog par byed/ nges par 'jog par byed/ nye bar 'jog par byed/ dul bar byed/ zhi bar byed/ nye bar zhi bar byed/ rgyud gcig tu byed/ mnyam par 'jog par byed/ ces bya ba yin no// zhes dang*/ kun las btus las/ zhi gnas gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nang nyid la sems 'jog pa dang*/ rgyun du 'jog pa dang*/ blan te 'jog pa dang*/ nye bar 'jog pa dang*/ 'dul bar byed pa dang*/ zhi bar byed pa dang*/ rnam par zhi bar byed pa dang*/ rtse gcig tu byed pa dang*/ mnyam par 'jog pa'o// zhes sems gnas dgur bshad la/ lhag mthong gi dbye ba ni/

dgongs 'grel las/ bcom ldan 'das lhag mthong la rnam pa du mchis/ byams pa rnam pa gsum ste/ mtshan ma las byung ba dang*/ yongs su tshol ba las byung ba dang*/ so sor rtog pa las byung ba'o// zhes mtshan ma las byung ba'i lhag mthong sogs gsum gsungs shing*/ de dag gi ngos 'dzin yang de nyid du/ mtshan ma las byung ba gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan 'ba' zhig yid la byed pa'i lhag mthong gang yin pa'o// yongs su tshol ba las byung ba gang zhe na/ de dang der shes rab kyis shin tu legs par ma rtogs pa'i chos de dag nyid shin tu legs par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir yid la byed pa'i lhag mthong gang yin pa'o// so sor rtogs pa las byung ba gang zhe na/ de dang der shes rab kyis shin tu legs par rtogs pa'i chos rnams la rnam par grol bas/ shin tu legs par bde ba la reg par bya ba'i phyir yid la byed pa'i lhag mthong gang yin pa'o// zhes so/ kun las btus las/ lhag mthong gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos rnams la rnam par 'byed pa dang*/ rab tu rnam par 'byed pa dang*/ yongs su rnam par rtog pa dang*/ yongs su dpyod par byed pa ste/ gnas ngan len dang mtshan ma'i gnyen po nyid dang*/ phyin ci log las 'byin pa dang*/ phyin ci log ma yin pa la sems 'jog pa'i phyir ro// zhes chos rnam par 'byed pa'i lhag mthong dang*/ rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i dang*/ yongs su rtogs par byed pa'i dang*/ yongs su dpyod par byed pa'i lhag mthong bzhi bshad pa la/ de dag dang gong gi zhi gnas kyi dbye ba de dag la sogs pa'i ngos 'dzin skabs su babs pa 'ga' tsam rim gyis 'chad par 'gyur la/ 'dir ni bstan bya dngos sgom gyi rtsa ba zhi gnas kyi nyams btsal nas rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la/ mdor byas pa'i rnam dbye ni gnyis te/ rten can dang rten med do// de yang so so skye bo rnams kyi shes pa ni glo bur du dmigs pa med par byed mi nus pas/

yid kyi rnam par shes pa gdon mi za bar dmigs pa zhig la dmigs dgos pas rten can dang por ston/ de la yang rlung med rlung can gnyis/ rlung med la yang*/ chos rje ras pas/ rten ni rde'u shing bu dang*// mar me bla ma dag la gtad// ces gsungs pas/ bla ma zhes pa'i zur gyis dag pa'i rten rnams ston pas na/ ma dag pa rde'u shing bu la rten bca' ba dang*/ dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs la rten bca' ba gnyis su byed pa'i dang po ni/ gang zag blo dman pa dag thog mar sems kyi gnas cha tshol ba la sems 'dzin gyi yan lag ma nges pa ci rig pa'i sgo nas sems gnas 'tshol bar rung ste/ til+li pas/ lta stangs sems 'dzin yan lag du ma yis// rig pa ngang la mi gnas bar du gcun// zhes gsungs pas so// de yang mdo dang ka ma la shi la'i sgom rim rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la dmigs nas sems gnas bsgrub pa nyid thog ma'i dmigs par bshad kyang*/ sgrub brgyud gong ma rnams kyis blo dman pa dag la dang po nyid nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i rnam pa blo yul du 'char ba rang yang ches dka' bas phal pa'i dngos po la sems 'dzin byas na sems gnas bde blag tu skye bar dgongs nas/ dang por ma dag pa'i rten la dmigs par bzhed de/ de dang mthun par jo bo'i byang chub lam sgron las/ zhi gnas yan lag rnams nyams pas// rab tu 'bad de bsgoms byas kyang*// lo ni stong phrag dag gis kyang*// ting 'dzin 'grub par mi 'gyur ro// de phyir ting 'dzin tshogs la las// gsungs pa'i yan lag la dmigs nas// dmigs pa gang rung gcig dag la// yid ni dge la bzhag par bya// zhes gsungs te/ ting 'dzin tshogs la las phal par dmigs pa sogs kyang bshad pas so// slob dpon byang chub bzang pos kyang*/ kha phyir bltas pa la dmigs pa gnyis te/ khyad par can dang phal pa'o// zhes bshad pa'i phal par 'di yang 'du bas so// de la gong du bshad pa bzhin lus gnad legs par bcas nas bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab dgos te/

rtogs ldan gyi bla ma dag mos gus sgom gyi mgo bo zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rje btsun byams pas/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam de// dad pa kho na'i rtogs bya yin// zhes gsungs pa la/ dad mos 'jug pa gcig pas so// des na bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus su mos pas spyi bor bsgom/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud la rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab dngos grub zhus nas bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim pas thugs yid gnyis med du 'dres par bsam pa'i ngang nas/ mdun du lta stangs kyi thad kar rde'u 'am shing bu sogs kyi rten dkar mdangs dang 'od 'tsher ba min pa mig la mi gnod pa phra mo zhig bzhag ste/ dmigs rten de la mig lta stangs mi 'gyur ba'i brtod phur bzung nas sems lhod kyis gtad pas/ de las gzhan gang du'ang sems ma 'phros shing ma yengs tsam bya la/ dmigs rten de nyid la'ang btsir 'dzin du byas nas/ de'i kha dog dang dbyibs sogs la blos rnam par rtog pa dang dpyad gzhig gi bsam mno sogs mi gtong bar/ mdor na dmigs rten ma dor tsam las ched du mi bsam pa'i rtog med du hu re lhan ne gnas pa'i cha 'tshol ba yin la/ de yang yud tsam re'i gnas cha rnyed na/ gnas bzhin pa'i ngang de nyid 'phro bcad la cung zad ngal gsos nas yang gnas su 'jug yun thung la grangs mang du sbyong ba yin te/ sgom 'phro gcod pa la sgom dang bzang gyes byas pas phyis sgom 'dod pa 'ong la/ thog ma nyid nas ngal dub che bar byas na sna bsun khyer nas phyis sgom mi spro ba 'byung ba'i nyen no// kha gcig rde'u dang shing bu la brten nas gnas cha 'tshol ba ni gzhung gzhan du ma bshad pas sems gnas sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ma shes pa'o snyam pa ni mi rigs te/

blo dman dag gis kyang sems gnas bde blag tu rnyed pa'i dgos pa dang*/ tshegs chung la don che ba'i zab gnad snang ba'i phyir ro// gzhung gzhan las bshad pa ni gong du drangs pas shes so// 'o na sems gnas yid kyi shes pa'i steng du sgrub dgos kyi/ rde'u shing bu sogs phyi rol gyi rdzas mthong ba'i dbang shes la brten nas sgrub pa mi rigs so snyam na skyon med de/ dbang shes rnams yul la g.yo ba'i gtso bo mig gi rnam shes kyis byed la/ dbang shes la brten nas yid shes g.yo ba shas che ba'i gnad kyis mig gi dbang po mi g.yo ba'i lta stangs byas pas de'i dbang shes kyang mi g.yo zhing*/ dbang shes gzhan yang g.yo ba nyung ba dang*/ de ma g.yos na yid shes kyang g.yo ba nyung ba'i gnad kyis gnas cha rnyed sla ba dang rde'u shing bu lta bu la yid dang mig shes gtod pa tsam bya ba yang*/ de las gzhan du yid mi yengs pa'i mtshan ma tsam yin pa'i phyir te/ dper na don mi brjed pa'i rtags mtshan la brten nas don dran pa bzhin no// de ltar na sems 'jog pa'i mtshan ma la nges pa med de/ rnam par bam pa sogs mi sdug pa'i mtshan ma nyid la'ang mtshan ma mi 'dra ba mang du gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ yi ge'i gzugs dang sgra dang 'od dang ming la sems 'jog pa sogs mang du bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ sgom rim nyid du'ang zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa la nges pa med par bshad pa'i phyir ro// gzhan yang sngon slob dpon klu sgrub gyis ma he'i rdzi bo rgas 'khogs pa zhig rjes su 'dzin par bzhed nas gang gsal dris pas ma he nyid gsal zer nas/ ma he'i rwa mgo la skyes par bsgom du bcug pas de la gsal snang skyes nas rwa phug pa la thogs pa tsam du byung ba/ slar med par bsgom pas sngar bzhin gyur la rim gyis gdams pa gzhan yang bsgom nus su gyur pa'i 'phro la tshe dus byas pa/ skye ba phyi mar nā ga bo dhi klu'i byang chub bya ba sku tshe de la mchog thob pa'i skyes bur gyur pa dang*/

bya bshor ba zhig la/ slob dpon bi ru pas gdams pa btab kyang bya bshor gyi rtog pa kho nas sgom skyer ma 'dod pas zan la bya'i gzugs brnyan byas nas/ de rnams gsod pa'i tshul la dmigs rten byas nas sgom bcug pas sems ngo mthong ba dang*/ slob dpon bi na pi waṃ gi sgra la sems rten byas te bsgoms pas grol ba sogs kyi lo rgyus mang du 'byung ba'ang 'di dang phyogs mthun te/ gang zhig gang la 'dris pa dang goms stobs gang che ba la brten nas bsam gtan skye sla ba zhig 'di'i dgos pa'i gtso bo yin pa las/ sems can las dang po pa dge ba la cher ma goms pa/ dkon mchog la dad gus kyi bag chags mi bzang ba dag gis thog ma nas dag pa'i rten la sems 'dzin mi nus pas/ dang por bag chags 'dris goms kyi rten du rde'u shing bu la sogs dngos po phal pa la sems 'dzin bde zhing don 'grub par 'gyur pa'i phyir ma dag pa'i rten la sems 'dzin bstan la/ skal ba dge ba'i rigs can sku gzugs sogs kyi dmigs pa la sems 'dzin nus pas ni de ltar bya ba bsngags te/ de las bsod nams kyi tshogs lhag por thob pa'i dgos pa yod pas so// gnyis pa dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs la rten bca' ba la/ rim pa gsum gyi dang po sku gzugs brnyan la rten bca' ba ni/ sngar gyi rde'u sogs ma dag pa'i dmigs rten gyi tshab tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lugs su blug pa lta bu'i 'bur ma'am ri mor bris pa lta bu/ cha tshang legs shing ma rnying pa grums ral la sogs pa'i skyon med pas mthong na mi mthun bral ba zhig bkur bsti dang bcas pas mdun du bzhag ste/ rgyal ba'i snang brnyan ltar yod pa bsod nams ches che snyam du spro ba dang bcas shing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o snyam du 'dun pa bskyed rjes/ mig dang sems gzhan du ma yengs ma 'gyur bar de nyid la rtse gcig tu blta/

de yang sku gzugs kyi dbyibs dang sgros gtsang min dang rgyu'i khyad par sogs la mi rtog par sku de la ma yengs pa'i dran rten tsam zhig byas nas rang babs lhod por skyong*/ rnam rtog dran pas ngos 'dzin/ yengs skabs su 'dun pas 'tsho skyong byed/ rgyun ring bas lus gnad mi bde ba/ sku mi mthong ba/ sems gnas skyong mi thub pa sogs byung na 'phro bcad de ngal gsos nas slar gsol ba btab ste sngar bzhin bskyang ngo*// de ltar snang brnyan la sems zin nas/ de dang rang gi bar du snang brnyan de 'dra ba zhig bsgom la sems 'dzin/ de la gnas na sku gzugs mig snga na mi 'jog par/ mdun du rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zlas brgyan pa'i steng du ston pa shākya'i rgyal po'i sku/ gser sbyangs pa'i ri bo nyi gzhon gyis 'khyud pa'i kha dog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ mtshams sprin gyi kha dog 'dzin pa'i chos gos gsum gyis mdzes shing*/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhig yid kyis dmigs la sangs rgyas dngos su bsams shing*/ yon tan rjes su dran pa'i dad 'dun bskyed rjes sngar bzhin sems 'dzin/ de yang dang po 'dris pa'i bag chags la bslab/ de nas rgyal ba'i sku brnyan dngos bcas la bslab/ de nas dngos med yid kyis sgom pa'i skur bslab pa ste blo dman rim gyis khrid pa'i thabs so// gzhan du dang po nas dmigs pa gsal ba la dngos bcas gyi sku la sems gtod pa sngon du 'gro mi dgos te 'di ni gsung dang thugs la'ang shes par bya'o// tshul 'di ni bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis khyim bdag rgan po zhig la stong pa nyid kyi don bstan pa ma 'tshal nas khyod ci la sems 'gro zhes dri ba'i tshul mdzad pa na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sku la sems 'gro zhes gsol bas/

de ni shin tu legs te/ de ltar na bdag nyid bsgoms te de la sems gtod cig gsungs pa ltar byas pas ring por mi thogs par chos don zab mo rtogs par bshad pa sogs yod cing*/ bzang skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bzang skyong 'di lta ste/ dper na nga da ltar khyed kyi mdun na 'dug cing chos ston pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa de dag yid la bya ste/ sangs rgyas gdan la bzhugs shing chos 'chad pa/ rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa/ gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa lta na sdug pa/ sku phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yid la bya'o// de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan de rnams re re yang bsod nams brgyas bskyed pa bsgom par bya'o// zhes sogs mang du gsungs shing*/ ting 'dzin rgyal por yang*/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i sku lus kyis// 'jig rten mgon po rab tu mdzes pa ni// dmigs pa de la gang gis sems gtod pa// byang chub sems dpa' de mnyam bzhag ces bya// zhes dang*/ ka ma la shi las/ rnal 'byor pas thog mar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs ji ltar mthong ba dang ji ltar thos pa la sems bzhag nas zhi gnas bsgrub par bya'o// zhes bshad/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la dad pas blta ba 'di sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dbyings zhes bya ste/ bsod nams rgya chen thob pa/ sgrib pa thams cad 'dag pa/ yon tan thams cad rdzogs par mdo sde las bshad cing*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ sangs rgyas yid la byas pas ni// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mthu stobs dang yon tan gyi mdzod 'dzin par 'gyur ro// ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thams cad skad cig gis mngon du byed do// rgyal ba'i gsung rabs thams cad kyi mnga' bdag chen por gyur nas sa dang lam gyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od zer bye ba phrag brgya'i dbang bskur thob par 'gyur ro// gang zhig sangs rgyas yid byed pa/

de yi mdun du thub pa bzhugs// zhes gsungs shing*/ ting 'dzin rgyal por/ mtshan mo mkha' la skar mas gang ba ltar// 'gro dang 'chag dang nyal dang 'dug pa na/ mi gang thub pa'i zla ba dran byed pa// de yi mdun du ston pa rtag par bzhugs// zhes gsungs/ de ltar mnyam rjes thams cad du sangs rgyas yid la byed pas ma yengs pa de dang mi 'bral bar byed/ 'di dus bying rmugs kyi skyon byung na/ lta stangs dang sems 'phangs bstod nas/ rgyal ba'i sku'i gtsug tor ram mdzod spu'am zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la sems 'dzin/ 'phro rgod kyi skyon la lta stangs dang sems 'phangs dmad nas/ rgyal ba'i sku'i lte ba zhabs khri pad sogs la sems 'dzin pas sel la/ bying rgod med pa'i tshe sku yongs rdzogs la sems gtad pa'o// gzhan yang mdun mkhar gyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khrir sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog zla ba chu shel ltar dkar ba/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can dang*/ glang po ches bteg pa'i khri la mi bskyod pa sku mdog be ḍūr+ya'i snying po lta bu sa gnon mnyam bzhag rdo rje dang bcas pa/ rta mchog gis bteg pa'i khri la rin chen 'byung ldan gser gtso ma lta bu mchog sbyin dang mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ rma byas bteg pa'i khri la sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ shang shang gis bteg pa'i khri la don yod grub pa sku mdog mar gad kyi ri bo ltar ljang ba skyabs sbyin dang mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ de rnams kyang shin tu zhi ba'i 'dzum zhal can/ mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa/ chos gos rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa/ 'od zer rab tu 'phro bas phyi nang kun gsal bar byed pa la sems gtod pa dang*/ gzhan yang rigs gsum gyi mgon po dang bla ma rdo rje 'chang ngam rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pa sogs dang*/ yi dam phag mo sogs rang gi yid ngor bab cing gsal ba gang yin pa tsam zhig la dang por sems 'dzin/

de la brtan nas dmigs pa'i bogs 'byin nam rtsal 'don lta bur zhar byung gi dgos pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gcig kho nar sems 'dzin sun pa ltar snang ba la yang sngar sangs rgyas la sems zin nas/ yi dam byang sems gzhan mang po la rim pas sems bzhag na legs par 'gyur ba yod la/ rang nyid kyi nyon mongs gang shas che ba'i gnyen po'i sgom tshul yang gti mug shas che bas rnam snang*/ zhe sdang la mi bskyod pa/ nga rgyal la rin 'byung*/ 'dod chags la snang mtha'/ phrag dog shas che na don grub kyi sku la sems 'dzin te/ de ltar byas pas rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa de dang de'i dbang gis bsags pa'i dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i go 'phang mngon byed kyi rten 'brel rgyud la bsgrig cing*/ gnas skabs su nyon mongs pa de'i mgo non par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang shes rab dman pas 'jam dbyangs/ snying rje dman pas spyan ras gzigs kyi skur sems 'dzin pa sogs kyang shes par bya'o// yang na rigs lnga dang shakya'i rgyal po sogs sangs rgyas dang*/ byams pa 'jam dbyangs sogs byang sems/ bde phag sogs yi dam gyi skur rang nyid sgoms nas de la sems 'dzin pa yang legs shing 'thad pa yin te/ slob dpon byang chub bzang pos/ lus nyid lha'i rnam par dmigs pa dang*// zhes gsungs pas so// gnyis pa gsung yig 'bru la rten bca' ba ni/ rang gi mdun du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dwangs shing nya gang ba sran ma tsam zhig gi steng du hūm̐ yig phra mo spus bris pa lta bu sngo mdangs 'od zer lngas 'khor ba zhig bsams te hūm̐ yig de kha la sems ma yengs par gtad/ yengs na 'dun pa bsgrims te dmigs pa bsgom/ rgyun ring bas bying ba sogs su gyur na 'phro bcad de sngar bzhin bsgom/ 'dir gong ma dag bying rmugs sel thabs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'bar ba dang*/ de'i steng du hūm̐ yig kyang dkar la 'tsher ba zhig tu bsgoms la sems gtad/

rgod na hūm̐ yig mthing nag /nyon mongs che na dmar ba/ rgyun du kha dog lnga ldan bsgom/ zhes kyang gsungs/ der ma zad zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i oṃ yig dkar po dang*/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i āḥyig dmar po dang*/ sngar gyi hūm̐ yig ste/ rdo rje rnam pa gsum gyi sa bon dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'am ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥrnams rim bzhin dkar sngo ser dmar ljang ba sogs kyang bsgom par bzhed de/ de la 'bru gsum dmigs pas ni sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag nas rdo rje gsum thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa dang*/ 'bru lngas ni nyon mongs dug lnga sbyangs nas ye shes lnga thob par byed pas rang rgyud nyon mongs kyi shas dang bstun nas de dang de sgom pa sngar bzhin rung ngo*// yang na mdun mkhar zla nyi la sogs pa'i steng du bla ma'am yi dam gyi sa bon la de'i sngags kyis bskor ba rang sgra sgrogs pa'i dbyibs sgra zung 'jug la sems gtad pa dang*/ rang nyid sngar bshad ltar gyi rigs lnga rdor sems phag mo la sogs par gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba'am nyi ma la rang rang gi sa bon sngags kyis bskor ba la sems 'dzin pa sogs kyang ngo*// gsum pa thugs thig le la rten bca' ba ni/ rang mdun gnya' shing gang tsam gyi nam mkhar/ thig le bya'i sgong nga'i dbyibs 'dra ba sran ma tsam pa rang bzhin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa kha dog sngon po 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'am yang na kha dog sna lnga pa zhig bsgoms nas/ de la sems gtod pa sogs sngon bzhin bya/ der sems brtan nas thig le bya sgong tsam la sogs par je che dang*/ yungs 'bru'i tshad la sogs par je chung du dmigs shing sems bzung ba yang dmigs pa'i rtsal 'don du 'gyur la/ bying rmugs la thig le'i 'od kyis rang nyid kyi lus phyi nang thams cad gsal bar bsams/ rgod na thig le nag po 'od 'phro ba la sems gtad pas sel ba yin/

yang na rang lhar gsal ba'i snying gar thig le sngon po la sems 'dzin pa sogs dang thig le dkar dmar mthing gsum dang*/ sna lnga pa tha dad so sor bsgom pa dang*/ lnga tshoms lta bur bsgom pa sogs kyang rung ngo*// phan yon ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ snying gi dbus su thig le gnas// thig le'i gzugs la mi shigs pa// ye shes 'od kyi rnam 'khrigs ldan// des na rdo rje rnam par bsgom// rdo rje bdag med ma 'khor lo// bskul ba'i cho ga bsgom par bya// mkha' 'gro ma yi sna rtser ni// yungs kar rnam par gnas par bsgom// 'gro ba ma lus yungs kar du'o// de lta bu ni bsgoms gyur na// rang byin rlabs pa rab tu 'grub// ces dang*/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis/ 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kun// thig le'i gong bu gcig byas nas// stong gsum ma lus khyab pa dang*// yungs 'bru tsam du bsdu bar bya// de dag phra rags gang yin dbus// rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang*// rdo rje'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas// spro dang bsdu ba'i bdag nyid las// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang*// sgyu 'phrul gar gyi dbang phyug thob// ces gsungs pa dang phyogs mthun no// gzhan yang thig le sngon po bsgoms pas chos sku mi 'gyur ba thob pa dang*// kha dog lnga ldan gyis sku lnga ye shes lnga rdzogs thob pa'i nus pa bskyed cing*/ snying gar thig le bsgoms pas nyin mtshan gyi 'od gsal 'char ba sogs so// zhar byung thugs phyag mtshan la dmigs pa'ang bshad par bya ste/ de la mdun du zla ba'am nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dkar po/ rdo rje sngon po rin chen ser po'am cha brgyad pa sna tshogs sam sngon po/ pad+ma dmar po/ sna tshogs rdo rje'am/ ral gri ste rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rnams 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin tshon gang ba tsam dang*/ gzhan yang yi dam gyi phyag mtshan rdo dril/ rdo rje/ gri thod/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga la sogs pa dang*/

rigs bzhi'am lnga'i phyag mtshan de dag rang lhar gsal ba'i gnas bzhi'am lnga la sogs par sgom yang legs te/ spyi bor 'khor lo/ mgrin par pad+ma/ snying gar rdo rje/ lte bar rin chen/ gsang bar rgya gram mam ral gri'o// 'phral phugs kyi phan yon ni thig le'i skabs bstan pa dang mtshungs so// de yang slob dpon byang chub bzang pos/ mtshan ma phra mo la dmigs pa dang*/ thig le la dmigs pa dang*/ 'od zer gyi yan lag la dmigs pa dang*/ dga' ba dang bde ba la dmigs pa'o// zhes thig le la dmigs pa dngos su gsal zhing*/ mtshan ma zhes pas phyag mtshan la dmigs pa bstan to// 'di dag kyang gsang ba sgron me'i rgyud las// dmigs pa dag la brten nas su// mi dmigs pa dag rab tu skye// mi dmigs pa la goms byas na// dmigs med ngo bo nyid du 'grub// ces gsungs pa ltar gtso bor dmigs pa la brten nas dmigs med bskyed pa'i ched du yin la/ yang sngon du bla med kyi dbang thob cing*/ bskyed rim gyi man ngag rgyas pa thos pas skabs 'dir mngon byang lngas bskyed pa la sogs pa'i bskyed rim sems 'dzin gyi slad du bsgoms na yang rnam pa gcig nas legs par 'gyur mod/ phal cher la dmigs pa'i bya rtsol mang pos sems g.yeng rkyen du 'gyur ba yang snang bas de dag gis ni re zhig ci bder bzhag 'os pa kho na'o// sku gsung thugs la dmigs pa'i rim pa 'di yang slob dpon byang chub bzang pos/ kha phyir bltas pas thob pa la gnyis te/ khyad par can dang phal pa'o// de la khyad par can la gnyis te/ sku la dmigs pa dang gsung la dmigs pa'o// zhes sku dang gsung la dmigs pa dngos su bstan nas/ thugs zhar la 'phangs pa'i don no// de ltar sku gsung thugs la dmigs pa rim par bshad pa'ang go rim tsam yin la/ gang zag gcig gis gsum po rim can du bslab dgos nges ni ma yin zhing*/ 'ga' zhig rim can gyis bogs su 'gyur ba yod pas de ltar gtan nas don med pa'ang min no// gnyis pa rlung can ni/

rje btsun til+li pas/ blo dman skye bo ngang la mi gnas na// rlung gi gnad bzung rig pa bcud la bor// zhes gsungs te/ sems rlung gi bzhon pa can yin pas rlung 'ching na sems 'ching ba'i gnad kyis rlung can gyi khrid ston pa 'di la/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa la brten pa dang*/ bum pa can la brten pa gnyis so/ de'i dang po ni/ lus gnad chos bdun skyon med par bcas/ bla ma la gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dug gsum dag pa'i rten 'brel du rlung ro lan gsum bsal rjes/ sna bug gi rlung rngam pa sgra can rgod bag med par dbugs rang babs kyis nang du 'ong ba dang*/ phar dal bus rang 'gros su 'gro ba de nyid la shes pa gtad pas/ rlung sems 'dres pa ltar song ba de/ dang por khug pa bdun dang nyer gcig tsam nas/ mthar nyi khri chig stong drug brgya tsam rdzogs pa'i bar du 'grang bar bya la/ ma goms pa'i dbang gis sems yengs shing lus gnad dang rlung skyon can du song na/ slar rlung ro bsal nas gnad rnams bcos te sngar bzhin du bslab bo// de la bgrang bya yang*/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gcig tu byas pa thengs gcig dang gnyis sogs nas bgrang ba ste de las sems gnas rnyed par 'gyur ba ni dgos don gyi gtso bo dang*/ zhar byung gi 'bras bur nyin zhag gcig tu rlung ji tsam rgyu ba'i grangs la phrig tshud pa'am nges pa rnyed par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'byung 'jug gnas pa so sor brtags shing*/ de gsum yang lus kyi cha shas thams cad nas sam/ phyogs gcig kho na las rgyu ba dbugs 'byung rngub kyi rjes su 'gro bas gzhigs shing dpyad pa na/ lus kyi cha shas sam tshogs pa gang las kyang rgyu ba ma yin par shes te rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid la mkhas par 'gyur ro// tshul 'di ni dpal sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor pas ni mnyam bzhag pas// 'jug pa'i rlung ni bgrang bar bya// ji srid 'bum la sogs pa'i grangs// sgra dang bral bar rtag tu bzla// sgrub pos sgra dang bral bar ni// 'bum bzlas yongs su rdzogs pa na// tshe nyams pa yang lo lnga ru// 'tsho ba 'di la the tshom med// ces tshe bsrings thabs su 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang bcas nas gsungs so// 'gro 'ong la bslab pa ni/

rlung grangs la mi rtog par dbugs dang shes pa bsres te/ dbugs lte ba nas sna rtser 'gro ba dang*/ sna rtse nas lte ba'i bar 'ong ba de gnyis kyi ngo bo la bltas nas ma yengs rtse gcig tu 'jog pa yin la/ de'i zhar byung gi 'bras bu rlung lnga'i kha dog mthong zhing zin par 'gyur te/ de la sa rlung ser po/ chu rlung dkar po/ me rlung dmar po/ rlung gi rlung nag po/ nam mkha'i rlung sngon po sogs so// ring thung zin pa yang 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sna sgo nas phyir sor bcu drug gi mtshams tshun nam mkha'i rlung dang*/ bco lnga pa nas rlung gi rlung*/ bcu bzhi nas me rlung*/ bcu gsum nas chu rlung*/ bcu gnyis kyi mtshams nas sa rlung rgyu ba rnams phyir sor tshad je thung dang*/ nang gi lus la je ring du song ba'o// de ltar kha dog dang ring thung zin nas 'byung ba so so'i rlung ma 'dres pa la sems 'dzin te/ dper na sna g.yas nas sa rlung rgyu ba'i dus der sa'i rlung ser po snang bar 'gyur la/ de tsam rlung de dang shes pa bsres te bsgoms pas sa rlung gi stobs sam nus pa zin pas mtshon 'byung lnga'i rlung gi stobs nus zin par 'gyur ro// de nas 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa la bslab pa ni/ sna sgo'i rlung phyir 'gro ba'i dus rlung de yi ge gzab ma'i oṃ yig dkar po'i 'phreng ba oṃ gyi gdangs can du thon par dmigs/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe hūm̐ yig sngon po'i phreng ba hūm̐ gi gdangs can/ gnas pa'i tshe āḥyig dmar po gcig gam du ma āḥ'i gdangs can zhig tu gyur nas lte 'og tu gnas par bsams te/ de ltar rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum ye ge gsum du bsgyur nas de dag gi 'phro 'du gnas gsum la dmigs par bya'o// de yang bshad rgyud rdor phreng las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams// sngags ni bzung zhing bzlas brjod bya// de yis dngos grub myur 'grub 'gyur// zhes gsungs/

phyi ma 'di'i 'bras bu dbugs kyi rgyu ba zad pa zhes bya ba phyi rol du rlung rgyus pas de la brten pa'i sems yul la mi 'phyan pas phyir chad kyi 'char sgo zad par 'gyur ro/ de yang rim lnga dang bsre 'pho sogs su 'byung ba'i rdor bzlas ni// brjod dang dmigs par bcas pa dang*// brda' gyur dang ni don dam mo// zhes rim pa bzhi yin la/ de bzhi la brten pa'i lam rdzogs dang rten 'brel gyi sgor lus rlung dmigs gsum ji ltar bshad pa'i rim pa ma 'chol bar nyams su len dgos mod kyang*/ zhi gnas la slob pa'i skabs 'dir gzung dran gyi rten tsam yin pas de dag rim can du'am nang gses blo gang la 'jug pa gcig tsam bsgoms pas kyang chog go /gzhan yang mdo phyogs kyi sgom rim rnams su rnam rtog shas che bas rlung sgom par bshad pa'i sgom tshul la/ mdzod kyi rang 'grel du/ bgrang dang rjes 'gro 'jog pa dang*// rtog pa dang ni bsgyur ba dang*// yongs dag rnam pa drug tu 'dod// ces bshad pa las/ dang po bgrang ba ni/ dbugs 'byung rngub nyer gcig nas chu srang dang chu tshod kyi bar grangs ma 'chol bar bgrang ba la dmigs nas sems 'dzin pa'o/ rjes 'gro ni/ de'i 'og tu rlung 'di lus thams cad du 'jug gam 'ga' zhig tu 'jug ces lus thams cad kyi mthar thug par rjes su 'gro ba dang ldog pa la dmigs pa'o// 'jog pa ni/ thams cad la khyab par rnam par mi rtog pa la sems 'jog pa'o// rtog pa ni/ rlung gi ngo bo mi dmigs par rtog pa'o// bsgyur ba ni/ rlung la dmigs pa'i blo de nyid zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa gzhan du bsgyur ba'o// yongs dag ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa yongs su dag pa'i rtog med du sgom pa'o// yang rlung bgrang ba ni sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar na dran pa'i dbang gis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba la rtog ce na/

yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du bgrang ba dang*/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du 'gro ba dang 'ong ba rjes su dran pas bzung bar bsam gtan dag la zhugs pa ni/ yang dag pa'i chos don dam pa la gnas pa'i sems can zhes bya'o// bsam gtan yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom pa zhes bya'o// zhes bsngags pa dang bcas te gsungs so// gnyis pa bum pa can la brten pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dgang ba yis ni lus dag nas// dug dang rims kyi tsha ba 'phrog /bum pa can gyi rlung bcings na// sgo yi bu ga 'gag par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ steng dang 'og tu 'gro ba'i rlung*// yid kyi kha sbyor du byas te// de yi rnal 'byor goms pa gang*// de yis brten pa'i go 'phang thob// dang*/ yang na bum pa can sbyor bas// thams cad du ni 'chi las rgyal// bdag nyid rig pas rkang mthil bar// thams cad rlung gis kun bkang ste// bum pa can la rten bcas nas// zhes bshad do// dus 'khor las kyang*/ kha yang btsum ste sna yi bu ga gnyis ka dag nas phyi rol dag gi rlung ni ma lus pa// srog gi shugs kyi dkrugs te dri ma med pa'i glog dang mtshungs pa'i thur sel rlung dang sbyar byas pa// dus kyi goms pa'i sbyor ba dag las zla ba nyi ma me yi dbus su ro mnyam 'gyur// lus la zas la sogs pas bkres pa dang ni skom pa 'phrog ste 'chi ba med pa nyid kyang ster// zhes pa ltar ro// de'i tshul/ lus gnad bcas te rlung ro lan gsum sogs bsal nas/ phyi rol gyi rlung dal bus sna bug gnyis nas rdzogs par brngub ste lte 'og tu bskyur/ 'og rlung cung zad 'then pa kha sbyor du bzung*/ mi bde ba med tsam du rgod bag dang sgra med par sel gyis btang bar bya'o// de ltar phyi nas brngub pa dang nang du bsdom pa dang phyir btang ba'i bar thams cad du sngar bzhin yid ma yengs par dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas bya ba dang*/

khyad par nang du ji srid bsdam pa'i bar yid rtog med du had de sim me hu re gnas pa'i rgyun bsring ba yin no// de lta bu yang dang por khug pa bdun dang nyer gcig sogs kyi bar ci rigs la dbugs ngal gso zhing goms nas yun je ring la sbyangs te/ de ltar sbyangs pas sems rgod du song na ma yengs tsam ma gtogs sems khong glod/ des kyang 'tshub na dub pa yin pas dub bsangs ci rigs bya/ mgo 'khor ba'am sems yengs na rlung kha skyes pas bza' btung bcud chen brten cing bku mnye bya/ rlung bsdam pa'i gnad kyis bying ba shas cher mi 'byung la/ byung na lta stangs dpangs bstod nas hur 'don pa sogs bya/ rtog pa 'og 'gyus lta bur ma song bar dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas rtog pa phra mo 'char ba la skyon du mi bzung*/ 'khu 'phrig mi bya bar slar dran pa'i stobs bskyed de shes pa gting grims la kha lhod pa lta bu zhig bya'o// yang na nā ro zhabs kyis/ brngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// 'phang bar bya dang rnam pa bzhi// sbyor ba bzhi ldan ma shes na// yon tan skyon du 'gyur ba'i nyen// zhes dang*/ lcags kyu bzhin du dgug par bya// bum pa bzhin du dgang ba dang*// rgya mdud bzhin du bsdams nas su// mda' ltar gyen du 'phang bar bya// zhes gsungs pa'i sbyor ba bzhi ldan kyi rlung sbyor brten par legs pas// de ni sna gnyis nas lhan cig par rlung ro chung 'bring che ba ste lan gsum bsal ba'am/ yang na sna g.yas nas rlung drangs pa g.yon nas 'bud/ g.yon nas drangs pa g.yas nas 'bud/ gnyis ka nas brngub pa gnyis ka nas phyir bsal ba de lta bu shugs chung ba dang 'bring dang chen po ste dgu phrugs su bsal rjes/ steng rlung sna nas dal bus rngub pa dang 'og rlung yid tsam 'then pa lte 'og kha sbyor du bsdams nas ring du bzung*/ de nas bzung ba de nem gyis mnan la slar rngub chung gcig byas/

g.yas gzhil g.yon gzhil cha mnyam du gzhil rjes cung zad cig bsdam/ de nas dang po dang mthar shed chung zhing bar du shugs che ba de ltar dbyung ba las slar yang sngar bzhin bskyar te nyams su len pa'o// yang na rlung ro bsal rjes sna nas dal bus brngub pa khog smad du yid tsam mnan/ khog stod yang sang nge bzhag nas mi bde ba med kyi bar du bsdom pa ste/ de ni dgang ba'i rlung tsam zhig go /de ltar rlung gi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshe lus gnad rgyab mdun g.yas g.yon so sor yo ba dang*/ spyi bo gos kyis gtums nas rlung 'dzin pa dang*/ drag tu brngub pa dang*/ rlung ro legs par ma bsal bar rngubs pa dang*/ phyir gtong ba'i tshe lus nang du rlung lhag lus pa// mi thub par rtseg rtseg zer ba tsam du sdom pa sogs rlung bzung ma legs pa'i skyon rnams bsal bar byas la/ tshul bzhin du rnal 'byor byas pa'i phan yon ni/ las dang po pa'i bum pa can chung 'bring che gsum dang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i dus kyi chung 'bring che ba sogs rim pas khegs par 'gyur la/ de'i mthus sngar drangs pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lung gi dngos bstan dug dang rims la sogs pas mi tshugs pa gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang*/ tshig de'i sbas don yang mthar thug gi 'bras bur 'gyur te/ de la dug ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang rims kyi tsha ba shes bya'i sgrib pa ste de gnyis 'dag cing*/ sbyor bzhi gnas gcig tu zhugs pas sgo rnams kyi rgyu ba 'gags nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde ba chen po thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dpal sa ra has/ nam zhig sbyor bzhi gnas gcig la ni zhugs pa na// bde chen mchog ni nam mkha'i khams su mi shong ngo*// zhes so/ 'dir kun mkhyen chen pos khrid yig tu/ rlung gi 'pho ba zad pas sems yul la 'phyan pa'i rnam par rtog pa'ang zad par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa dang don gcig tu 'bab la/

rlung gi rgyu ba zad pa dang*/ 'pho ba zad pa gnyis don gcig gam snyam du dogs pa la/ rlung gi rgyu ba zad pa ni phyi rol du rlung ma rgyus pa de la brten pa'i sems yul la mi 'phyan pas phyir chad kyi 'char sgo zad pa/ 'pho ba zad pa ni nang ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phro 'du'ang dmigs med du thim pas phyi nang gnyis 'dzin gyi 'pho ba zad pa 'di dngos ni 'phags pa'i dbang du byas pa yin yang*/ rjes mthun pa tsam zhig zhi gnas kyi skabs su'ang 'byung ba yin no// don du na zad pa zhes pa med par song ba lta bu ma yin te/ 'gag med kyi rtsal sus kyang mi 'gog pas thog ma nas tha ma'i bar du rang bzhin gyis gnas pa yin no// 'o na gang zhe na gnas 'gyu'am gshis gdangs kyi rnam dbye rang bzhin shes pa'i dbyings su rdzogs pa la zad pa'i brda' sbyar ba tsam mo// 'on kyang skabs 'dir ni rlung la brten pa'ang gnas cha rnyed pa'i ched du yin pa'i phyir phal cher gyis bum can chen po khegs pa la sogs pa tsam du 'bad pa shas chung yang dbang rnon 'ga' zhig skabs 'di kho nar lam rdzogs pas shes sgrib dang nyon sgrib dag pa sogs kyi yon tan skye ba yang srid pa yin no// yang sems rtog pa'i 'khor lo ma zad pa'i rlung gi rnal 'byor gyis ni don gang yang mi 'grub cing ngo mtshar mi che ste/ rgya gar na nya pa dang mu tig gsad pas 'tsho ba dag kyang rlung 'dzin par byed la/ 'jam dbyangs bud+dhas/ rlung sems dbyer med mi skyong ba'i// rlung rkyang 'bud pa skyi ser te// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gar mkhan 'dra// zhes gsungs pa ltar du zad la/ rlung dang mi rtog pa zung 'jug tu bsgom pa ni yang dag pa'i nyams len yin pas/ rje sgom tshul gyis/ rlung sems dbyer med man ngag 'di// sgom chen rab kyi nyams len yin// zhes gsungs so// de dag ni grub chen til+li pas/ lta stangs sems 'dzin yan lag du ma yis// rig pa ngang la mi gnas bar du bcun// zhes gsungs pa'i don du 'gyur la/

dbu ma snying po las kyang*/ yid kyi glang po log 'gro ba// dmigs pa'i ka ba brtan po la// dran pa'i thag pas nges bcings nas// shes rab lcags kyus rim dbang bya// zhes sems glang po ma dul ba dang 'dra ba de/ dmigs pa ka ba brtan po dang 'dra ba la/ dran pa thag pa dang 'dra bas bcings nas mi sdod na/ shes bzhin lcags kyu dang 'dra bas btab ste rim pas rang dbang du bya ba'i dpe don du yang 'gyur ro// gnyis pa rten med kyi sgom rim ni/ rgyud las/ dngos med dngos po la brten nas// rten pa med par dngos por bya/ yid med yid ni byas nas su// cung zad tsam yang mi bsam mo// zhes pa'i don la gzhol ba ste/ sngar bshad pa'i rde'u shing bu sku gsung thugs rten rlung la brten nas sems 'dzin sgrub pa lta bu ma yin par gang la'ang sems rten bcas pa med pas na rten med ces bya/ dwags rgyud pa 'ga' zhig rten can rten med gnyis kyi dang po rde'u shing bu dang sku gsung thugs la rten bca' ba gnyis/ rten med la rlung can dang rlung med gnyis kyi phyi ma ni/ gong gi sems 'dzin gyi yan lag de dag gis sems kyi gnas cha ci rigs pa rnyed pa de nyid rten med gtad med du sbyor bar byed pa'i tshul zhig la bzhed cing*/ de'i tshul yang lus gnad sngar bzhin las/ phyi'i dmigs rten dang nang gi dbugs 'gro 'ong sogs la sems gtad de 'dzin pa'i sbyor ba mi bya bar/ sems gang la'ang brten sa med cing yid byed kyi rtog pas kyang ma dkrugs par sems rang lugs kyi ngang nyid la sems 'jog ste/ de yang sngon 'di ltar byas pa dang byung ba sogs 'das pa rnams kyang mi bsam/ phyin chad 'di bya dang 'di byed sogs ma 'ongs pa'ang sems mi spro/ 'phral ji ltar 'dug dang 'di ltar snang sogs da lta'i rtog dpyod kyang yid la mi byed par sems rang gar lhod de shig ge bar 'jog pa yin la/

'jog tshul 'di ni gsang 'dus las/ sems ni sems min byas nas su// ci yang bsam par mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa la sogs pa'i don du bzhed mod/ 'on kyang kun mkhyen chen po pad dkar zhabs kyis phyag chen khrid yig 'dir ni rlung med kyi sgom tshul de 'dra ba zur du ma gsungs kyang*/ bzhag thabs kyi gnad rnam pa bzhir gsungs pa la sogs pa'i khongs nas thon la/ de bas na 'dir ni rten med la thol skyes rbad gcod/ gang shar bzo med bzhag thabs kyi gnad bshad pa ste gsum mo// de las dang por thol skyes rbad gcod kyi lam 'di ni dri mas dri ma 'khrud pa dang*/ khyi'us khyi'u 'byin pa'i dpe lta bur rtog pa'i gnyen por rtog pa gtong ba'i lam mo// de yang 'das pa dran pas ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar gyi 'ching ba mngon rgyu blos ched du brtags pa'i bsgom pa/ cang med du lta ba'i stong pa rnams tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i ngan pa'am/ de'i yid byed yin pas spong ngo*// de sbong mkhan yang dus 'dir rnam par rtog pa ma skyes par bya'o snyam pa'i blo kho nar zad do// de la re zhig gzung dran gyi ming btags nas 'dir de la sgom du byas nas des snga ma rnams bzlog par byed do// des na thog mar rtog pa ma 'phros pa bya'o snyam pa dang*/ 'phro na dran pas bzung nas 'phro gcod pas thol skyes rbad gcod du btags so// de yang lus gnad sngar ltar dang*/ bla ma la gsol ba drag po btab/ dag ma dag gi rten dang rlung sogs dmigs rten du mi 'dzin par/ rig pa ngar dang bcas pas rnam rtog skad cig kyang ma skyes par byed dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po sngon du 'gro bas sems la dwangs cha thon nas phyi rol gyi yul snang sogs rnam rtog sna tshogs gcig rting du gcig skyes pa la/ gang skyes kyi rtog pa'i 'phro 'phral 'phral bcad de bsgom/ de 'dra ba yun bsrings pas rnam par rtog pa je mang du song nas mthar rnam rtog gcig rting la gcig skye bas rgyun mi chod pa lta bur 'byung ba la brten/

bdag 'dra ba sgom gyi skal ba med pa yin nam/ rnam rtog ni sngar las kyang mang zhing rgod par song snyam pa'i blo bsun pa skye yang*/ sngar bsgom pa'i 'du shes med pa dang*/ cung zad yod srid kyang bying rmugs la sogs pa'i dbang du song nas 'chor ba yin/ 'dir sgrims te bsgom pas rnam rtog ngo shes pa ste/ dper na khang stong du rkun ma yang yang 'ong kyang bdag po med pas mang nyung gi cha mi 'byung*/ bdag po yod dus lan gsum bzhi tsam re la yang mang ba'i snang ba byung zhing*/ bdag po yod pas rkun ma ngos 'dzin pa ltar sems la bdag po byas pa'i yon tanagyis rnam rtog mang nyung gi phrig tshud pa ste/ skad cig ma re re tsam sems gnas pas rnam rtog gi skye 'gag shes/ de'i dbang gis rnam rtog mang du song ba 'dra zhig byung ba ma gtogs rnam rtog rgyun chags su skye mang nyung yod pa ma yin te/ skad cig snga ma la skye zhing 'bri/ phyi ma la'ang de 'dra ba ldabs te skye ba chos nyid pas 'khor ba zo chun gyis 'khyud mo zhes bya ba yin/ 'di dag ni chos rjes/ dang por rnam rtog bkag nas sgom// zhes dang mdo sde rgyan las/ rnam g.yeng nyes pa mthong ba'i phyir// de la mi dga' zhi bar bya// zhes dang*/ sam+bu ṭar/ stong dang stong min bzung ba las// rtog pa nyung min skye bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa dang mthun la/ de rtog pa bkag pa dang mi rtog pa sgrub par 'dod pas de'i rkyen gyis rnam par rtog pa rgyun mi chad pa skye bas byung tshor skye 'gag shes pa de la rnam rtog ngos zin gyi nyams zer/ gnas pa dang po ri gzar chu 'bab lta bu'i dus te/ ti l+li pas/ las ni dang po gcong rong 'bab chu 'dra// zhes gsungs pa dang 'brel ba'o// 'di la 'ga' zhig gis skyon du 'dzin par snang yang*/ 'di tsam zhig ma sgrims na gang shar bzo med du glod pa'i gnad ka gzhan mi rnyed do// gzhan yang dang po'i dus sems gnas gnas 'dra bas rnam rtog skabs re tsam las mi 'gyu bar snang snyam 'byung ba kun kyang rig pa dwangs snyigs ma phyed pa yin pas de'i gnyen por yang skyong tshul 'di gal che'o// rje zhang gi zhal nas/
